points.title: 贵族教育
points.description: 1689年1月18日，孟德斯鸠出生于法国波尔多附近的拉布雷德城堡。作为贵族家庭的长子，他接受了当时最好的教育，先在朱利安学院学习，后进入波尔多大学攻读法律。1713年，他的父亲去世，他继承了家族的贵族头衔和波尔多高等法院议员的职位。这一时期，他接受了传统的古典教育，但已经开始对当时的政治制度产生思考。
points.descriptionEn: Born on January 18, 1689, in the Château de La Brède near Bordeaux, Montesquieu received an excellent education typical of the French nobility. He first studied at the Julian Academy and later attended the University of Bordeaux to study law. In 1713, following his father's death, he inherited his noble title and became a counselor in the Parlement of Bordeaux. During this period, he received traditional classical education but began developing critical thoughts about contemporary political systems.

points.title: 司法生涯与文学创作
points.description: 1714年，孟德斯鸠正式成为波尔多高等法院的议员，开始了他的司法生涯。1716年，他继承了伯父的波尔多高等法院院长职位，这一职位使他有机会深入了解法国的法律体系。在此期间，他开始文学创作，1719年化名发表了《波斯人信札》，这部作品通过两位波斯贵族游历法国的视角，辛辣地讽刺了当时法国的社会制度和政治生活，一举成名。这部作品展现了他敏锐的观察力和批判精神。
points.descriptionEn: In 1714, Montesquieu officially became a counselor in the Parlement of Bordeaux, beginning his judicial career. In 1716, he inherited the position of President of the Parlement of Bordeaux from his uncle, which gave him deep insights into the French legal system. During this time, he began his literary endeavors, publishing anonymously in 1719 'The Persian Letters,' a work that used the perspective of two Persian nobles traveling in France to satirize French social and political institutions. This work established his reputation as a sharp observer and critic.

points.title: 巴黎社交圈
points.description: 1721年，《波斯人信札》的成功使孟德斯鸠进入了巴黎的精英社交圈。他在巴黎结识了许多启蒙思想家，包括伏尔泰、丰特奈尔等。1725年，他辞去了波尔多高等法院院长的职务，专注于学术研究和写作。在巴黎期间，他开始构思他的政治哲学巨著《论法的精神》，并进行了大量的阅读和研究，为这部著作奠定了基础。巴黎的学术氛围和思想交流极大地拓展了他的视野。
points.descriptionEn: Following the success of 'The Persian Letters' in 1721, Montesquieu entered the elite Parisian social circles. In Paris, he met many Enlightenment thinkers including Voltaire and Fontenelle. In 1725, he resigned as President of the Parlement of Bordeaux to focus on academic research and writing. During his time in Paris, he began conceptualizing his magnum opus 'The Spirit of the Laws' and engaged in extensive reading and research that would form the foundation of this work. The intellectual atmosphere and exchanges in Paris significantly broadened his horizons.

points.title: 欧洲考察
points.description: 1729年，孟德斯鸠开始了为期两年的欧洲旅行，先后访问了奥地利、匈牙利、意大利、德国、荷兰、英国等国家。在英国，他停留时间最长，深入研究了英国的君主立宪制和议会制度。这次旅行对他思想的形成产生了深远影响，特别是英国的政治制度让他看到了权力制衡的可能性。他详细记录了各地的政治制度、社会风俗和法律体系，这些资料成为后来《论法的精神》的重要素材。这次旅行使他从一个法国思想家转变为具有国际视野的比较政治学家。
points.descriptionEn: In 1729, Montesquieu embarked on a two-year journey across Europe, visiting Austria, Hungary, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands, and England. He spent the most time in England, where he studied the British constitutional monarchy and parliamentary system in depth. This journey profoundly influenced the formation of his thought, particularly British political systems showed him the possibilities of power separation and checks and balances. He meticulously documented the political systems, social customs, and legal frameworks of various regions, which became crucial material for his later work 'The Spirit of the Laws.' This journey transformed him from a French thinker into a comparative political scientist with international perspective.

points.title: 思想成熟与著作完成
points.description: 1734年，孟德斯鸠回到家乡拉布雷德城堡，开始专注于他的政治哲学研究。1748年，经过近二十年的思考和写作，他的代表作《论法的精神》出版。这部系统阐述了三权分立理论，对后世政治制度产生了深远影响。在拉布雷德期间，他还完成了《罗马盛衰原因论》等重要著作。1755年2月10日，孟德斯鸠在拉布雷德逝世，享年66岁。他的思想通过《论法的精神》等著作影响了美国宪法的制定，成为现代民主制度的重要理论基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1734, Montesquieu returned to his family estate at La Brède, where he focused on his political philosophy research. After nearly twenty years of contemplation and writing, his masterpiece 'The Spirit of the Laws' was published in 1748. This work systematically articulated the theory of separation of powers, profoundly influencing subsequent political systems. During his time at La Brède, he also completed other important works such as 'Considerations on the Causes of the Greatness of the Romans and Their Decline.' On February 10, 1755, Montesquieu died at La Brède at the age of 66. His ideas, particularly through 'The Spirit of the Laws,' influenced the drafting of the U.S. Constitution and became a fundamental theoretical basis for modern democratic systems.

appraisal.zh: 孟德斯鸠是启蒙运动的重要代表人物，其比较研究方法被视为现代政治科学的基础之一，三权分立理论则成为宪政民主的核心原则，对各国宪政建设影响深远。不过也有研究者指出，他的理论带有历史局限：分权构想过于理想化，对英国政治的描述含有理想化成分，未充分反映当时的阶级矛盾与权力不平等，其贵族身份也使思想保留保守色彩。尽管部分观点已被超越，他对政治制度与社会关系的研究方法仍具持久价值。
appraisal.en: Montesquieu is a key figure of the Enlightenment: his comparative method is considered foundational to modern political science, and his theory of separation of powers has become a core principle of constitutional democracy, deeply influencing constitutional development worldwide. Yet some researchers note his historical limitations—his separation of powers is overly idealized, his account of British politics contains idealized elements and does not fully reflect the class contradictions and power inequalities of the time, and his noble background left conservative traces in his thought. Though some views have been surpassed, his approach to political systems and social relations remains enduringly valuable.

supporter.zh: 孟德斯鸠被誉为现代政治科学的奠基人之一，他的三权分立理论为现代民主制度提供了理论基础。支持者认为他通过比较研究方法开创了政治社会学的新领域，强调法律与社会的相互关系。他的思想不仅影响了美国宪法的制定，也为世界各国宪政建设提供了重要参考。孟德斯鸠倡导的自由、平等和法治理念，至今仍是现代政治文明的核心价值。
supporter.en: Montesquieu is regarded as one of the founders of modern political science, and his theory of separation of powers provided the theoretical foundation for modern democratic systems. Supporters argue that he pioneered the field of political sociology through comparative research methods, emphasizing the interrelationship between law and society. His ideas not only influenced the drafting of the U.S. Constitution but also provided important references for constitutional development worldwide. Montesquieu's advocacy of liberty, equality, and rule of law remains central to modern political civilization.

critic.zh: 批评者指出孟德斯鸠的理论存在历史局限性，他的三权分立理论过于理想化，忽视了权力在实际运作中的复杂性和相互渗透。一些学者认为他对英国政治制度的描述存在理想化成分，未能完全反映当时英国社会的阶级矛盾和权力不平等。此外，孟德斯鸠作为贵族，其思想中仍保留了某些保守主义色彩，对民主的认同存在一定限制。
critic.en: Critics point out that Montesquieu's theory has historical limitations, as his separation of powers is overly idealized and fails to account for the complexity and interpenetration of power in actual operation. Some scholars argue that his description of the British political system contains idealized elements, not fully reflecting the class contradictions and power inequalities of contemporary British society. Additionally, as a nobleman, his thought retained certain conservative tendencies, with limitations in his endorsement of democracy.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，孟德斯鸠被视为启蒙运动的重要代表人物，他的方法论和思想对后世产生了深远影响。现代政治科学将他的比较研究方法视为学科基础之一，而三权分立理论则成为宪政民主的核心原则。在流行文化中，孟德斯鸠常被描绘为理性与自由的象征，他的思想被简化为权力制衡的代名词。尽管他的某些观点已被历史发展所超越，但他对政治制度与社会关系的研究方法仍具有持久价值。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Montesquieu is regarded as a key figure of the Enlightenment, whose methodology and thought have had profound influence on later generations. Modern political science considers his comparative research methods as foundational to the discipline, while his theory of separation of powers has become a core principle of constitutional democracy. In popular culture, Montesquieu is often depicted as a symbol of reason and liberty, with his ideas simplified as synonymous with checks and balances. Although some of his views have been surpassed by historical development, his research methods on political systems and social relations remain enduringly valuable.

self.zh: 自由不是想做什么就做什么，而是有权做法律所许可的一切事情。
self.en: Liberty consists in doing what one ought; and a citizen is said to be free when he is not afraid of the law.
